note: California is the largest western state by tracked facilities (112) and by recorded events (25), and every discretionary data center there files a CEQA notice, so CEQAnet is the highest-value unresolved western source. It has stayed unresolved because its API and bulk-export path are unconfirmed and confirming them needs a look from an unrestricted network. Registered 2026-09-09 as a probe rather than a fetch: nothing here can start a download, and the report only says what each URL is and which tool could take it onward.
